verdict.rationale: Bun's package manager is a standalone CLI that runs entirely on the user's own machine in any Node.js project (bun-docs-17, bun-docs-26), and users report adopting it as a package manager on its own (bun-comm-3). It keeps a local global cache with a configurable path (bun-docs-64) and has an offline mode that never touches the network (bun-docs-5), so the core product needs no vendor-hosted service. Missing for 10: no evidence of the source license or open-source availability, no documentation on pointing it at a self-hosted or private registry, and no independent corroboration of fully air-gapped use.
